message: The other day, while I was rummaging through our old bags, I stumbled upon our emergency go-bags. Instead of feeling overwhelmed, I decided to make it a little family project. We gathered around the kitchen table, sharing stories about our adventures while we sorted through everything. 🌟 It turned into a cozy evening, packing snacks and favorite items, and I realized that preparing together can be just as special as the memories we create. Have you ever turned a task into a fun family moment?
